summary: Scage Future filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited financial results for the six months ended December 31, 2025 (first half of fiscal year 2026). The filing reports a 91.3% revenue increase to $13.7 million, improved gross profit of $0.2 million (1.4% margin), and a net loss narrowing to $3.7 million from $4.0 million. No special-situation corporate event—acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring—is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, mapping to a standard periodic financial report under US securities laws. There are no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no risk-arb angle.
